Keeps your Fold widgets legible on every home screen page. When the home screen comes to rest, Fold Widgets takes one screenshot to see where the launcher has placed the wallpaper behind each widget, then redraws the widgets to match. Screenshots are only taken on the home screen, are never saved and never leave the phone.
